description: A hypnomantic corruption is giving visitors fleeting visions of terrible nightmares... I've tried seeing if I can change the visions to compel them to buy more expensive potions, but it didn't work. Let's just dispel it.
Customers keep drifting off mid-conversation, murmuring about half-remembered dreams. Word is starting to get around that this shop is an odd place to browse.
Something down in the cellar is holding a grudge, and it's souring the whole shop's mood — customers linger less and leave with their coin still in hand.
